text:
erin: quick flipbench run comparing A100 vs H100 across two regions (us-west1, eu-west1) for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, MPT-7B-instruct. goal = prefill + decode latency, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens at real-world seq lengths.
jonathan: nice — what setup? batch/concurrency/quant?
erin: summary: PyTorch 2.2 runtime, kernel set = optimized-cuda-v2, KV cache enabled, intel-style async io off. quant = q4_0 for 13B/7B runs, int8 (q8_0) for a quick sweep on MPT. batch sizes = 1,4,8. prefills at 512, decode up to 512. concurrency = 8 clients for scale numbers.
perf-bot: automated run report attached
perf-bot: ```
# perf summary (us-west1 / eu-west1)
Llama2-13B | A100: prefill=430ms, decode token=1.95ms, tokens/sec=360, $/1M=2.6
Llama2-13B | H100: prefill=260ms, decode token=0.95ms, tokens/sec=720, $/1M=1.3
Mistral-7B | A100: prefill=220ms, decode token=1.1ms, tokens/sec=550, $/1M=1.7
Mistral-7B | H100: prefill=140ms, decode token=0.55ms, tokens/sec=1050, $/1M=0.9
MPT-7B-instruct | A100: prefill=240ms, decode token=1.2ms, tokens/sec=500, $/1M=1.9
MPT-7B-instruct | H100: prefill=150ms, decode token=0.6ms, tokens/sec=980, $/1M=1.0
# notes: eu-west1 numbers within ~5% of us-west1 except H100 prefill a bit higher in eu due to infra variation
```
erin: high level: H100 is ~1.9x tokens/sec on average across the tested open models; prefill improvement is largest for 13B (1.65x). cost per 1M roughly halves assuming hourly GPU price parity used in this run.
rachel: did you try alternate kernels / fused attention for Llama2-13B?
erin: yes — fused-attn-on + ext-kernel reduced decode token latency further on H100 (0.85ms -> 0.7ms) but added ~40ms to prefill for our compile path. tradeoff depends on short vs long context workloads.
jonathan: for capacity planning: using 8 concurrent clients, H100 sustained tokens/sec ~720 for 13B -> that suggests ~1.35M tokens/min per GPU; so for expected 100M tokens/day you need ~74 H100-GPUs (with 20% headroom). on A100 you'd need ~140.
sam: curious about quantization quality drop with q4_0 vs q8_0 on MPT — any eval numbers?
erin: quick eval on our 500-sample instruction set: q4_0 MPT-7B delta BLEU-like metric ~ -0.8 points, q8_0 ~ -0.3. for Mistral q4_0 behaved within -0.4. Llama2-13B q4_0 had small regressions only on adversarial prompt set.
rachel: region note — eu-west1 H100 queues had higher tail latency during the run (p99 +120ms) likely due to noisy neighbor on that cluster; we'll rerun after isolation window.
jonathan: kernel/ops takeaway? default optimized-cuda-v2 is good baseline. enable fused-attn for decode-heavy paths on H100; for mixed prefill-heavy workloads prefer non-fused to keep prefill low.
erin: action items: 1) rerun eu-west1 H100 isolation test (@sam) 2) collect quality evals on the adversarial prompts for Llama2-13B/q4_0 (@rachel) 3) add these tokens/sec -> capacity calc to the infra cost sheet (I'll PR).
sam: ack on rerun, scheduling in next off-peak.
jonathan: can we also capture kernel-level perf counters and nvprof trace for the Llama2-13B fused vs non-fused paths? quick 30s trace should do.
erin: yes will enable perf counters on the rerun. anyone object to posting the perf-bot CSV to the eng-ml drive?
rachel: post it, add a short README with command lines used. :+1:
erin: thanks all — putting results in /eng-ml/benchmarks/gpu-flipbench/ and will link in PR. :rocket:
